svg.aria-label: With one sample the scene pass draws straight into the scene target and scene depth; with N samples it draws into a transient multisampled color and depth, which the hardware resolves at the end of the pass, color by AVERAGE and depth by MAX or SAMPLE_ZERO, into the same scene target and scene depth. After the pass everyone reads those two images, unchanged.
